tryonNote: Fit exactly like the shop photos: a slim, fitted white knit body that hugs her torso, with a DEEP RIBBED BAND (about a hand-span tall, vertical ribbing) from the natural waist down to the hem, cinching in at the waist and sitting snug over the hips. LONG length: the ribbed hem reaches down to her hip bones and fully covers the waistband of her leggings — no belly, no gap. Small shallow V-neck. Very full balloon / bishop sleeves that puff out and gather into long, tight ribbed cuffs at the wrists. NOT a plain loose sweater, NOT cropped.
